summary: CleanSpark, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 18, 2026, announcing that its wholly owned indirect subsidiary CSDC Finance I, LLC priced $2.276 billion aggregate principal amount of 7.875% senior secured notes due 2031 at 98.500% of principal, an issue price implying a yield above the coupon. The offering is expected to close September 25, 2026, subject to customary conditions, and is being sold under Rule 144A and Regulation S to qualified institutional buyers and non-U.S. persons. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes as a debt financing, not a special situation; watch leverage, collateral terms, and bitcoin-market sensitivity.
